description: This source file contains a fuzzing test for the Qpack encoder and decoder in the QUIC protocol implementation, exercising header encoding/decoding, stream data transmission, and error handling.

classes.name: EncodingEndpoint
classes.description: Manages a QpackEncoder instance and its error delegate, providing header encoding and stream delegate setup.

classes.name: DelayedHeaderBlockTransmitter
classes.description: Simulates delayed transmission of header blocks, maintaining order and fragmenting headers as per fuzzing data.

classes.name: VerifyingDecoder
classes.description: Decodes header blocks and verifies correctness against expected headers, handling asynchronous decoding scenarios.

classes.name: DecodingEndpoint
classes.description: Manages a QpackDecoder, creates VerifyingDecoders for header streams, and verifies decoded headers against expectations.

classes.name: DelayedStreamDataTransmitter
classes.description: Buffers and transmits stream data (encoder or decoder streams) with delays controlled by fuzzing data.

methods.name: TruncateValueOnInvalidChars
methods.description: Removes invalid characters (NUL, LF, CR) from a string.

methods.name: GenerateHeaderList
methods.description: Creates a header list with randomized headers based on fuzzing data.

methods.name: SplitHeaderList
methods.description: Splits header values along '�' or ';' separators into multiple headers.
